questiontext.text:
Question ID: ENG1_U01_L08_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG1.R.10; MLA.ENG1.V.01

Passage: The school added a response checklist to the online classroom. The checklist reminded students to paraphrase the passage, include relevant evidence, use precise vocabulary, and check punctuation before submitting work. Question: Which response best paraphrases the passage?

answer.text: A. The checklist helped students review important parts of a short response before submitting it.

feedback.text: Correct. This accurately restates the purpose of the checklist.

answer.text: B. The checklist made students write longer answers with more words.

feedback.text: Incorrect. The passage does not focus on length.

answer.text: C. The checklist replaced all writing assignments in the online classroom.

feedback.text: Incorrect. The passage does not say the checklist replaced assignments.

answer.text: D. The checklist was only about punctuation.

feedback.text: Incorrect. The checklist included several skills, not only punctuation.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: ENG1_U01_L08_GP_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG1.R.10; MLA.ENG1.V.01

Passage: The teacher posted sample responses before students submitted their own work. The samples showed how to answer the question, use evidence, choose precise vocabulary, and write complete sentences. Question: Which academic word best describes "precise vocabulary"?

answer.text: A. confusing

feedback.text: Incorrect. Precise vocabulary should make meaning clearer.

answer.text: B. exact

feedback.text: Correct. Precise means exact and clear.

answer.text: C. unrelated

feedback.text: Incorrect. Precise vocabulary should fit the topic.

answer.text: D. hidden

feedback.text: Incorrect. Precise vocabulary is not hidden.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: ENG1_U01_L08_GP_Q03

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG1.R.10; MLA.ENG1.V.01

Passage: The library added a display of student-recommended books. Students used the display to find titles their classmates enjoyed. Question: Which evidence best supports the paraphrase "The display helped students find recommended books"?

answer.text: A. The library had books.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This is too general.

answer.text: B. The display was in the library.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This gives location but not the result.

answer.text: C. Students used the display to find titles their classmates enjoyed.

feedback.text: Correct. This directly supports the paraphrase.

answer.text: D. Students were classmates.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This does not support the paraphrase.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: ENG1_U01_L08_GP_Q04

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG1.R.10; MLA.ENG1.V.01

Passage: The school posted bus updates on a screen near the office. Students checked the screen before leaving. Question: Which sentence uses standard English conventions correctly?

answer.text: A. the screen helped students check bus updates before leaving

feedback.text: Incorrect. This needs capitalization and punctuation.

answer.text: B. Because students checked the screen before leaving.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This is a fragment.

answer.text: C. The screen helped students it had bus updates.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This is a run-on.

answer.text: D. The screen helped students check bus updates before leaving.

feedback.text: Correct. This is a complete sentence with correct capitalization and punctuation.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: ENG1_U01_L08_GP_Q05

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG1.R.10; MLA.ENG1.V.01

Passage: The response says, "The checklist improved student writing because it reminded students to check evidence, punctuation, and sentence clarity." Question: Which Unit 1 skills are used in this response?

answer.text: A. Only spelling

feedback.text: Incorrect. The response includes more than spelling.

answer.text: B. Only oral presentation

feedback.text: Incorrect. The response is written and evidence-based.

answer.text: C. Unrelated details only

feedback.text: Incorrect. The details are relevant to the response.

answer.text: D. Paraphrase, academic vocabulary, evidence, and conventions

feedback.text: Correct. The response combines the major Unit 1 skills.
